Savanna Example Air partners with Blue Ridge Handling in Kampala

ENTEBBE, 21 October 2026 — Savanna Example Air today extended its cargo handling agreement at Entebbe.

"We are proud to support Savanna Example Air's growth in Uganda," said John Lee, Chief Executive Officer of Blue Ridge Handling, Savanna Example Air's ground handling partner.

Former Savanna Example Air Country Manager Uganda Paul Ssenyonga, now an independent consultant, attended the signing.
